audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats All Out as the form to avoid ('fight the tank, never the duelist') and tells you his W dash-and-stun peels your blink. Riot's own text says the opposite about the stun: 'When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.' The grounding on your R was also never stated, despite all three of his mobility tools being dashes.
audit.why: During All Out his W is damage with no displacement, so it is the window where your blink is least punishable — while his defences are reduced. Meanwhile Purgatory's grounding shuts off W, E and the R dash at once, which is what actually traps a champion with three escapes.
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten around both facts; dosFull[0].d re-keyed to the two-stack Ntofo pull; wants.foe[1] scoped to 'before he goes All Out'; spikes[1].text given the grounding.
